ops.statement: For a doc-diet or register-rewrite gate, a structural test suite does NOT guard prose invariants (pointer-name presence, forbidden-signature absence, meaning-preservation). Make each of those an explicit per-gate reviewer grep and Commander re-grep; never read suite-green as assurance for them.

ops.statement: A meaning-preserving doc/register diet handoff carries three explicit lists: exact BEFORE/AFTER for each edit, a MUST-SURVIVE operative-fact list, and a forbidden-signature list. This makes register-sensitive edits deterministic for the implementer and independently verifiable for the reviewer.
